title: October: the exams are published in Japanese
body:
The certification FAQ now states that "the exam and prep content are available in
English and Japanese", and documents how to move an appointment already booked
in English onto the Japanese version: cancel it in the Pearson account and
schedule the Japanese one, under the same 48-hour rule as any other change.

**Who this affects.** Anyone who reads Japanese more comfortably than English,
and anyone who read this repository before this entry appeared. Three pages here
said the exam was English only, which was true when it was written and is not
true now. Browser translation tools are still prohibited during proctoring, so
the readable languages are those two and no others.

The same FAQ section also names the delivery restrictions, now recorded under
[Availability](policies.md#availability): no OnVUE online proctoring on an ID
from Belarus, Cuba, North Korea, Russia, Syria or a restricted region of
Ukraine, and delivery to residents of Iran suspended from 8 September 2026 under
the OFAC General License G suspension. These are Pearson's restrictions, so they
move without the exam policy PDF moving.

title: October: a fourth role path, and a Claude Code badge
body:
Partner Academy's navigation gained two entries that are not certifications.
[Claude Forward Deployed Engineer](https://anthropic-partners.skilljar.com/path/claude-fde)
is a nine-course role path, three of whose courses are partner-only, and the
[Claude Code partner badge](https://anthropic-partners.skilljar.com/path/partner-badge-claude-code)
is an eight-course path ending in a scenario-based capstone. Both are listed in
[Learning paths and courses](learning-paths.md).

**Who this affects.** Nobody preparing for an exam. There is no Forward Deployed
Engineer certification, and a badge is not a certification, so the program is
still four exams across three certified roles at unchanged prices. A role path
appearing in the navigation is not evidence that an exam exists behind it.

The two pages describing the badge disagree on its length: the path says eight
courses and lists eight, the badge tile says ten.

title: August: the academy moved to a new home
body:
`anthropic.com/learn` now redirects permanently to
[academy.claude.com](https://academy.claude.com/), and the public academy is
branded **Claude Academy**. Course URLs changed shape with the move: a course
that lived at `anthropic.skilljar.com/claude-101` is now at
`academy.claude.com/courses/claude-101`, and several slugs were renamed rather
than simply moved.

**Who this affects.** Anyone holding bookmarks or following links from older
guides. The previous Skilljar pages still answer, so nothing is broken, but the
maintained home is the new one.

Completion badges already verified on `academy.claude.com` before the move, and
still do.

title: September: the catalog grew to twenty-six courses
body:
**Building Effective Human Agent Teams (Beta)** was added: five lessons and a
quiz on moving a team from single-player AI to multiplayer, aimed at team leads
rather than developers. It issues a completion badge and no certificate.

**Introduction to Claude Tag** followed later in the month: eleven lessons and
a quiz on Claude inside a team's Slack workspace, written for the person using
it in their channels rather than the admin installing it. Marked beta. It also
issues a completion badge and no certificate, which is why the badge count now
runs ahead of the certificate count on four courses.

Partner Academy also lists **Working with Claude Fable 5.1**, on where that
model sits and how to move a client build onto it. It returns 404 on the public
Claude Academy, so it is partner-only and is recorded in
[Learning paths](learning-paths.md) rather than in the course tables.

**Who this affects.** Nobody sitting an exam. Neither course is required for any
certification, and neither is exam preparation. It matters only if you are
working through the catalog.

title: August: the catalog grew to twenty-four courses
body:
Two courses were added: **Deploying Claude Enterprise with Confidence**, on the
five organization-wide decisions behind a rollout, and **AI Fluency for pK-12
Train the Trainer**, built with the American Federation of Teachers.

**Who this affects.** Nobody sitting an exam. No course is required for any
certification, and the guides say so explicitly. It matters only if you are
working through the catalog.

title: August 31: the Global Premier discount ends
body:
Through August 31, 2026, Global Premier partners paid nothing. From September 1
the standard 50% partner discount applies.

**Who this affects.** Global Premier partners who were planning to sit an exam
in the autumn. Booking before the deadline was worth the full fee.

title: July: exam guides published at version 1.0
body:
All four exam guides carry version 1.0, effective July 2026. These are the
authoritative scope documents: the domains, the weights, the item counts, the
sample questions, and the scoring rules.

**Who this affects.** Everyone. If anything on this site disagrees with a guide,
the guide is right.

title: June 30: delivery moved to Pearson VUE, badging to Credly
body:
The largest change in the program's history, and the one with the longest tail.

| What changed | Consequence |
| --- | --- |
| Exam delivery moved to Pearson VUE | Booking, rescheduling, ID checks and the proctoring experience all run through Pearson now |
| Badging moved to Credly | Credentials issue as Credly badges rather than on the previous platform |
| Architect Foundations fee | Raised from 99 to 125 USD |
| Pre-migration failed attempts | Failed Architect Foundations attempts from before the migration were cleared, so those candidates could retake with no waiting period |
| Credential validity | Extended from 6 months to 12, applied automatically to credentials earned before the migration, dated from when they were originally earned |
| Registrations in flight | Moved to Pearson in waves |
| The official practice exam | Retired, and not replaced |

**Who this affects.** Anyone who registered or certified before June 30, 2026.
Two cases still cause trouble. If you paid before the migration and never
received a Pearson link, contact
[certifications-support@anthropic.com](mailto:certifications-support@anthropic.com)
rather than registering again, which charges you twice. And if a pre-migration
credential never appeared in Credly, the badge email may have gone to an
address you no longer read.

The retired practice exam is the change candidates notice most. There is no
official practice exam any more. The sample questions inside each exam guide
are the only official items that exist.

title: June 25: the exam policy document was revised
body:
The current [Anthropic Certification Exam
Policy](official-sources.md) carries a revision date of June 25, 2026. It
governs conduct, identification, prohibited items, invalidation and appeals.

**Who this affects.** Everyone sitting an exam. It is short, and it is the
document people wish they had read only after something goes wrong.
